title: Single Class Version-Specific Case Statement (Overburdened Adapter)
pattern: A single client class that uses conditional flags (such as `use_super_db_v5_2`) to toggle between incompatible API versions or library versions of the same component, accompanied by comments promising to "delete this when we migrate."
why_bad: High coupling and Solution Sprawl. It combines multiple incompatible version contracts into a single interface. Developers will rarely delete the obsolete version branch for fear of breaking hidden legacy callers, meaning the "temporary" conditional check becomes a permanent architecture.
detection:
The linter must observe:
1. Conditional statements (`if/else` or `match`) checking software/library version variables to route behavior to distinct library client instances.
2. High structural similarity in the arguments passed to both version paths.
